title: Historical Weekend in D.C. with Weather Disruption

scenario.description: Two history buffs taking a weekend trip to Washington D.C. A sudden severe rainstorm forces their main outdoor activity on Saturday to be cancelled and replaced with indoor activities.

dynamic_events.description: A severe thunderstorm warning is issued for Saturday. Your outdoor activity has been cancelled by the operator. You need to find indoor historical activities to replace it.
resolution_requirements: Find indoor history or art museums to replace outdoor activity on Saturday
Ensure the replacement activities keep the total trip under the $1000 budget
Verify that transit time between the hotel, the new indoor activities, and existing meals is still feasible

expected_challenges: Handling weather-related constraints that completely invalidate outdoor plans for a specific day
Replanning a appropriate indoor alternatives without exceeding the budget
Re-validating the transit times and geographic feasibility of the new indoor locations
notes: Tests replanning driven by environmental factors (weather). The agent must understand the semantic difference between 'indoor' and 'outdoor' venues and adjust the schedule accordingly.
